commands.cmd: node --import ./test/platform-sqlite.mjs --test test/m/registers/guardrails.test.mjs test/m/registers/import.test.mjs test/m/registers/listing.test.mjs test/m/registers/plan.test.mjs test/m/registers/remove-watch.test.mjs test/m/registers/review.test.mjs test/m/registers/search.test.mjs test/m/registers/store.test.mjs

tests.name: R1: the listing names each register with its source, address and figures, each with its basis; a not-stated figure is null, never 0
R2: an import with a filer-id interest shows auto and its next check; one with a name shows by_act; a team pre-read with no interest shows none
R3: a beta register is listed beta with its reason key and every act on it is refused with that key, no request, nothing written; in beta the phase lets it be planned
R4: a register not yet measured is listed and refused by name, no request; after registerDefine the team's own definition is importable
R5: a gated or fee-bearing register is never fetched: planning, import and refresh answer member_act_required, zero requests, nothing written
R6: a proposal is held and listed; an identical one answers existed; an http address and one with a password are not public; a machine is refused; withdrawal keeps the row
R7: a team's own definition is accepted by the same rule, serves only that team, is listed under own and keeps every revision; a kept contact column, a gated host and a people-search are refused
R8: a project's subjects, identifiers and period prefill the filter with their basis; its address and notes add nothing; no project gives the whole register
R9: new rows are counted only when the source counted them for this filter and is append-only, else estimated, else not stated; each figure carries its basis; nothing is written
R10: a failed import contributes no timing to the next estimate
R11: each refusal by name, writing nothing; a machine credential is refused; the fake network sees no request during the act; control: a member's project import lands
R12: importDue and importWake answer from the queue; with nothing queued, false and null
R13: a running import shows its pieces and progress; pause runs nothing; resume continues from the cursor; stop keeps what was brought in and says so; a hidden import is NO_SUCH_REGISTER_IMPORT
R15: the reduction is stated by name and count, never a value; no sentinel is in the import row, the status, the listing or any answer; a register with no contact column shows none dropped

R68 (G10), R16: a full cycle (plan, delta, import, search, cite, compare, interest, refresh, change item) makes zero requests to any host but the register's own and leaves every AI table untouched; control: the spy sees a deliberately AI-using fixture
R17: a slice repeated writes nothing the first did: one index row per key and one object per segment digest; a changed row writes one more version
R18: every request names the register purpose in its agent and passes the governor; a cooling host pauses the import and it resumes after the wait, not counted as a failure
R19, R70 (G13): a hidden project's import, its filter and its rows stay inside it: no list, count, delta, search, compare, status or change names them for a non-participant; a participant sees them
R20 (G9, K4354): during a large import a member's list and search answer within budget and no write transaction holds the worker longer than SLICE_TX_MS
R22: a removal reaches the cells and the index only through the port: with the in-memory rowStore the row is removed, its tombstone recorded, and search no longer finds it
R23: with the shelf nearly full an import pauses with reason shelf and the figures, nothing written past the pause; resume is refused while it would pass 90%; with room it runs
R24: rows past the counted matches are still answered: 150 matches paged by 50 with the count bound at 100 join to all 150, the count capped

R25: a search that finds nothing says where it looked, with the dates, never 'does not exist'; with no import held it says so; a search stopped by its budget returns rows, says stopped, and carries no absence

R26 (G5 (6), R62, R65): searches are not logged: after a battery by name, amount and date no table holds a query string or the member's id against it; nothing is written, fetched, resolved or linked; control: the scan finds the sentinel in the search's own response
R27: compare on a use-limited register pages to RESULT_CAP rows in all and carries the limit; a repeated cite carries it too

R28: rowOf answers a row's kept cells, its place, fingerprints and the other imports' versions; an absent or hidden row is one answer; citeRow mints a content row over the row's extent, the extract's fingerprints equal the segment's hop, citing again answers existed, a machine is refused
R29: an added, a removed and a changed row are each reported; a different filter makes removals possibly_removed; two equal imports answer all counts 0; no answer holds a finding, score or suspect

R30 (G4, R69): a removed row is in no table, object, cache or log; searchRows and rowOf no longer answer it; the tombstone is listed and holds none of the row; a row over it is stale; a re-import does not restore it; any lawful ground the profile lists is accepted

R32: an interest by a filer id with watch true calls the listener once; a name is not watchable and is saved with watch false; a changed filter keeps the earlier version; a hidden project's interest is invisible; planning and a search never create one; forgetting ends the watch and keeps history

R33: a moved validator starts a refresh; agreeing validators fetch no body (REFRESH_UNCHANGED); only changed rows are stored; a name interest is REFRESH_NEEDS_MEMBER on the alarm and runs by registerRefresh; a gated register is member_act_required

R34: a refresh adding 3 and changing 1 row answers one entry with counts 3, 1, 0 and total 4; one with no difference answers none; a hidden project's entry is absent for others; no entry holds a cell; two refreshes with changes answer two entries

R46: the lookup by company number sends the key only to the service's host, keeps only the definition's kept columns and writes only a count; the service off sends nothing; a machine and the daemon are refused; a name is not a query

R61 (G1), R44: a watch is by a number or a stated interest, never an unattended search for a person: a name is not a scheme's query, an unlisted scheme names no register, a wildcard names none, a machine states, imports and refreshes nothing; the name interest is never ticked; a filer-id interest lands and ticks
R37, R62: nothing in this module resolves a name, proposes a match or creates a link: the entity tables are unchanged by any op; control: a member's addIdentifier still works

R63 (G3), R35: a file with sentinels in home_address, phone, an unlisted column and a free-text cell, imported whole and by filter, searched, cited, compared, refreshed, expunged and read out every way, leaves no sentinel in any table, object, content text, answer or error; the dropped columns are named, never valued

R64 (G12): after an import by a filter that matches 2 of 10 rows no object holds the 8 unmatched rows or the original's bytes; the hop holds the original's fingerprint, byte count and coverage, the dropped names, the filter fingerprint and 'reduced under K1485'
R65 (G5 (1)): a gated or fee-bearing register: import, refresh and the watch answer member_act_required, fetch nothing and record nothing but that answer

R66 (G6): every answer carrying a row of a limited register carries the limit and its text key; no op returns contributor identity as a list or file; an unfiltered search is NO_CRITERIA; a limited system's definition without its use limit is refused; the limited rows are never exported
R12 (G9, R67): an import killed between each pair of slices ends as an uninterrupted run does: the same row table, counts and segment digests

R68 (G10), R16: a full cycle (plan, delta, import, search, cite, compare, interest, refresh, change item) makes zero requests to any host but the register's own and leaves every AI table untouched; control: the spy sees a deliberately AI-using fixture

R30 (G4, R69): a removed row is in no table, object, cache or log; searchRows and rowOf no longer answer it; the tombstone is listed and holds none of the row; a row over it is stale; a re-import does not restore it; any lawful ground the profile lists is accepted
R19, R70 (G13): a hidden project's import, its filter and its rows stay inside it: no list, count, delta, search, compare, status or change names them for a non-participant; a participant sees them

R71: a team's own register is held to the same conduct: a contact column asked kept, no terms, a gated host or a people-search is refused; its first import drops every unassigned column; it is listed only to its team; a valid own definition imports
R73: registers answers content's row context for the captures it holds: holds, rowAt with the kept cells and the reduction block, null past the end; a capture of no import is not held

R63 (G3), R35: a file with sentinels in home_address, phone, an unlisted column and a free-text cell, imported whole and by filter, searched, cited, compared, refreshed, expunged and read out every way, leaves no sentinel in any table, object, content text, answer or error; the dropped columns are named, never valued
R36: no table column, answer key or word of the module holds score, rank, suspect, flag, risk, central, knows, conflict, suspicious or most connected; control: the scan catches a fixture key
R37, R62: nothing in this module resolves a name, proposes a match or creates a link: the entity tables are unchanged by any op; control: a member's addIdentifier still works
R38: every op of the route map is declared and every declaration has its arm; mutating ops are the member's acts
R39: refusals, states and absence sentences are words by key: a refusal's detail is the word table's sentence for its code
R40: every op answers within its stated time on the test copy (the figures are N1259-e §3's): the reads and the act that queues an import within 2,000 ms
R41: import rows, interests, proposals, own definitions and tombstones are exportable descriptors and hold no cell; rows and cells are never exported, whatever the register
R42: size: the module stays within its expected lines (2,500 to 3,500; BOB reports at 4,000)
R43: no jurisdiction in the module: no register, place, host or scheme of the profiles is named in its code; tests use the test profile

R61 (G1), R44: a watch is by a number or a stated interest, never an unattended search for a person: a name is not a scheme's query, an unlisted scheme names no register, a wildcard names none, a machine states, imports and refreshes nothing; the name interest is never ticked; a filer-id interest lands and ticks
R45: every row and extract answer carries its label key and a limited register's rows their text key; a limit-free row has no limit

not_verified: R14, R21, R30 and R72 are left not met and were not worked: R14 waits on acquisition T53-625 then registers T53-626 (K5814); R21 and R30 wait on acquisition T53-630 and record-core T53-629, then registers T53-631 (K5817); R72's packaged half needs a case module that reads a register extract and states it unverifiable, and none does yet (case-checker, case-carriage, case-disclosures hold no such code). The 1,000,000-row figures of R12, R20, R23, R67 were not run: they are measurements M-R3 and M-R7 (K5819).
